Contract CoCoMESystem::closeCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Set(CashDesk) = CashDesk.allInstance()->select(c|c.Id = cashDeskID and
		c.IsOpened = true),
		cashDesk: Boolean = obs.size()>0
	precondition:
		CurrentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		ClassName.allInstance()->includes(CurrentStore) and
		ClassName.allInstance()->includes(CurrentCashDesk)
	postcondition:
		let ob: CashDesk in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		ClassName.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		ob.IsOpened = false and
		result = cashDesk
}
